t: For an additional amount for “Military construction, Navy”, $140,000,000, to remain available until expended.

fable.w: This section is a pure appropriation of funds for Navy military construction. There is no tempting reading here: it mentions no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause authorizing the expenditure of funds for military construction. It does not mention any consultation, coordination, public comment, advisory boards, or other forms of participation with entities outside the federal government. It is purely a funding provision.
qwen_block.s: For an additional amount for “Military construction, Navy”, $140,000,000, to remain available until expended.

opus.w: The section only adds $140,000,000 to the "Military construction, Navy" account and keeps it available until spent. One might read the reference to a Navy construction program as implying some outside involvement, but the text has no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue. Like Example 1, it is purely about funding, so nothing in it is even on-topic for participation.
opus.b: 1. This is a plain appropriation. The only words that might look relevant are "Military construction, Navy", but that is just the name of the account. Nothing here involves anyone outside the federal government taking part in a decision. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking authority or right to sue.
